title: Red Hat Security Advisory: grafana-pcp security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-116591) affecting the Grafana plugin for Performance Co-Pilot in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support has been addressed. The issue involves a denial of service (DoS) caused by crafted zstd compressed input in the klauspost/compress library. Red Hat has issued an important security update to fix this vulnerability in the grafana-pcp package for multiple architectures. The update is available and should be applied to affected systems.
